findings.reader_payoff: The ayah turns from attributed self-made falsehood toward the people’s possible self-direction.
findings.containment: Formal parallel does not make fabrication and guidance the same meaning.

epistemic.reason: QAC morphology and the local pairing support the parallel; its interpretive contrast remains qualified.

findings.title: False attribution and truthful composition
findings.claim: The report carries false authorship and cutting/assembly pressure, while al-haqq carries reality-fitting truth and a tightly formed speech image; together they stage two accounts of making discourse.
findings.mechanism: Yaquluna meets iftarāhu as attribution; FRY’s cut/make branch meets HQQ’s weave branch, while truth makes coherence answerable to reality.
findings.reader_payoff: Before: a bare denial of invention. After: falsely assigned, cut-and-joined making meets speech whose form holds because it fits reality.
findings.containment: The ordinary accusation and truth assertion remain intact. Material-making is a qualified local image, not a historical claim about composition or proof by elegance.

epistemic.reason: Focus coordinates and roots match supplied words and branches; the integration comes from legacy_unbound HFT and the tight-weave card is qualified.

findings.title: An arrival opens a path after warning's absence
findings.claim: The negated prior arrival and before-you marker set a gap that the current warning enters; the warning is therefore first contact that can awaken orientation, while guidance remains hoped rather than completed.
findings.mechanism: The clause that no warner came before the addressee meets the current warning act and the final hoped-for guidance. Arrival repairs the local absence, warning awakens attention, and guidance supplies a subsequent direction.
findings.reader_payoff: Before: uninformed people are warned so they might accept correct doctrine. After: the first arrival interrupts non-orientation; alarm wakes attention, while guidance remains their subsequent movement along a newly indicated way.
findings.containment: This sequence is bounded to 32:3 and does not establish the full history of revelation or that the people actually became guided. The HFT synthesis is legacy_unbound; supplied Arabic verifies surface contact, while morphology and synthesis remain qualified.

epistemic.reason: The local word and root occurrences align with the HFT trace, but the before/after synthesis comes from a legacy_unbound nomination.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da şey gelir veya bir hedefe ulaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Atāhum carries the arrival event negated in the prior-warning clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Tunḏira names the current warning act in the same local sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The present warning meets the denied earlier arrival, making the current warning the first arrival within this clause's temporal frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The warning is presented as newly reaching a people for whom no earlier warner had arrived.
branch_activations.boundary: The claim concerns the local before/current sequence, not all historical communication.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey, zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından sonrakinin önünde bulunur.

branch_activations.activation: The temporal branch meets the explicit lack of prior arrival and the present warning, so 'before you' specifies the warning gap rather than standing as an isolated date.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The current mission is framed against a preceding period without a warner reaching them.
branch_activations.boundary: No calendar duration or universal historical claim is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da topluluğa korkulacak bir durumu haber vererek onları sakınmaya yöneltir.

findings.title: Warning as developmental intervention
findings.claim: Rabbika's source relation is heard through gradual cultivation when it meets the warning-and-guidance sequence; qawman can then appear as a people capable of deliberate response, rather than a fixed label.
findings.mechanism: The nurture/completion branch on Lordship meets the warning that jars attention; the people-word meets hoped guidance as a possible course they may undertake. These contacts turn the task into a developmental movement from incompletion toward direction.
findings.reader_payoff: Before: Lordship authorizes a warning delivered to a people. After: Lordship names a developmental intervention in which warning jars the community awake so it can rise into a sustained course.
findings.containment: This is a qualified local synthesis from a legacy_unbound HFT trace, not a claim about the community's actual response, an ethnic identity, or a surah-wide model of development.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers, independent triggers, and branch records are supplied; the developmental integration is an HFT nomination with legacy_unbound provenance.

branch_activations.boundary: This is an image carried by the branch, not a replacement for the ordinary source meaning.

findings.title: Unsettled speech against a still point
findings.claim: As an exploratory sound-material image, the reported accusation can be felt as unsettled verbal motion when the ordinary speech carrier meets al-haqq as fixed reality.
findings.mechanism: The accusation is spoken through qwl, while the HFT nomination draws an analogical motion branch at that carrier; al-haqq supplies a distinct reality-fitting counterpoint. Their contact makes the accusation feel unstable without translating qwl as 'shake.'
findings.reader_payoff: Before: the accusation and rebuttal are two propositions of the same kind. After: at an exploratory sound-material level, the accusation is unsettled verbal motion while الحق answers as fixed reality rather than a louder counterclaim.
findings.containment: Exploratory only. The packet registers root_001251/B006 under ق و ل but does not independently register the HFT's split-root ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping; treat the motion as sound-material analogy, never as the lexical meaning or translation of يقولون.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier has focus-local coordinates and a returning truth contrast, but its split-root motion association is not independently normalized in the packet.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The charge can be heard as unsettled verbal motion opposed by an answer grounded in reality.
branch_activations.boundary: The motion sense is analogical only and is not a lexical gloss of qwl.
